lines.text: Many learners say: She graduated the university.
Better: She graduated from the university.
From! She graduated from the university.

quiz.stem: She graduated ___ the university in May.

native.tip: Закончить вуз — “graduate from”: “She graduated from the university.”
native.caption: Ты тоже говоришь “She graduated the university”? 😅 По-русски «окончила университет» — без предлога, а по-английски нужен “from.” Правильно: “She graduated from the university.” Послушай Карлоса и повтори! Больше практики — в приложении Lexkite.
native.comment: Ответ: “from.” Окончить университет — graduate from the university. Напиши одно предложение о себе: “I graduated from …” Бесплатный тест для практики здесь: {link}

en.tip: To finish school, use “graduate from”: “She graduated from the university.”
en.caption: Do you also say “She graduated the university”? 😅 The Russian phrase has no extra word here, but English needs “from.” Correct: “She graduated from the university.” Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
